title: Contrast label travels with score.json; RT10 test for normal-run relabel to lineage_hold=false
outcome: a score.json lifted out of a D10 contrast run still says it was a no-lineage-hold run
acceptance: score.json carries lineage_hold:false when RunConfig.lineage_hold is false, omitted at default (existing score goldens unchanged, ADR-06-metrics s3 key list amended); bench never runs a contrast cell (asserted); RT10 test: a normal F2+ hold-0 run relabelled lineage_hold=false verifies config_mismatch with --head and 'not anchored' without
summary: score.json carries lineage_hold:false from config.json (omitted at default); run_cell raises on a contrast run, bench table header marks contrast; RT10 relabel test added. ADR-06-metrics s3 amendment NOT written (outside my scope, edit was denied): needs owner.
review: [kabir · done] Verified. Env score/bench/redteam 98 passed 3 skipped (uid tests, macOS); container 1079 passed 1 skipped on a fresh build. A first container run hit 6 failures (contracts_15/16, policy r2) because concurrent edits landed mid-build; they did not reproduce. Label can't be dropped: score reads lineage_hold from config.json (never score.json); contrast run always emits lineage_hold:false next to hold; relabelling a normal run gives verify --head config_mismatch and 'not anchored' without a head; relabelling a contrast run back to true fails F4 (existing test). bench run_cell raises on a contrast config; agg header marks [CONTRAST: NO-LINEAGE-HOLD]. Non-blocking nit: the relabel test only checks ks score exit 0. It should also assert the rescored score.json has lineage_hold false. ADR-06-metrics s3 key list amendment is with anaya.
